nom: No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum

avis.texte: I took my time with this, used it religiously for a few weeks. I didn't expect the results I received. My skin felt amazing typically I have very dry skin around my eyes at night, and oily during the day. With making this a part of my skincare routine my under eye felt less baggy and tired looking. I will be purchasing this product again, and would definitely recommend.
This goes on so smooth. It doesn't get sticky or greasy . I highly recommend!!!

the product has good packaging texture and smell. but in each application it had an exfoliating effect as it detaches my skin, not recommended under makeup. If it brightens the face but does not notice much the lift effect

I love No 7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum. It is a lightweight serum that absorbs quickly and there is no tacky after feel. My skin feels satiny smooth and nicely hydrated after using it. It has a very pleasant scent as well. I have noticed my skin tone has evened with less red areas and it has brightened in appearance. My skin feels firm and plump which lessens the fine lines around my eyes. I have oily skin and this serum leaves a matte feel and does not produce extra sebum. This has become my favorite serum. I have noticed real results from the first use and I highly recommend it.
Very soothing serum for the face. Using for 4 days my skin was soft and luminous. However the serum caused a little skin dryness.

I've been using this product for about 2 weeks in the morning, it's been great for my very dry skin. I've noticed a more smooth silky texture to my skin and I feel it has helped the dark spots I have targeted. Love the consistency of the product and it's at a great price point.
I love the feel in my face. It's light and airy. I use it before I put on my moisturizer. Although I still haven't noticed any difference, I will continue to use it.

This product is amazing! Very light weight but very powerful results. It went on like water. After 7 days I noticed less wrinkles and my dark spots were disappearing. I have never had a product that works as well as this. I would highly recommend it.

I feel younger and prettier! I'm absolutely shining here. I feel totally like I found the fountain of youth. I'm just happy now. I'm thrilled. I can't believe I found the holy grail in this product. I think this is the product for every woman looking for a serum that will lift without going to a surgeon.
I love the way this makes my skin feel and it has helped all the fine lines on my face.

avis.titre: Three Generations of Women: All Approve!
avis.texte: I'm a total skincare product junkie. I have tried so.many.things. This No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum stands out though - it's a really perfect addition to pretty much anyone, and everyone's, daily routine. Serums are honestly one of my favorite products - you use a serum first, under your day or night cream, or under a sunscreen if you wear that. They're pretty much always a light, thin product, because you're layering it under your other products. Yet, some of them can feel slightly heavy or greasy when layered. But not this one - it's so soft and light, goes on like water - but better, because it adds this slight slippery, velvety glide and glow. I use it, my 69 year old mom uses it, and my 10 year old daughter who's obsessed with beauty routines already, uses it too. It works great on all three of our very different skin types. Highly recommend this one to everybody.
I have been using my lift and luminate for a short time and am already noticing subtle changes

No7 products are always very high quality, and this Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum is no exception! After just one use my skin is softer and feels nicely hydrated (but not oily or greasy). A very small amount is all that is needed for the entire face and neck, as the formula is very light and goes on smooth. I am very impressed by the results.
I am allergic to a lot of face products. I was weary a out trying this but, I am glad that I did. I have not had any break out and my face looks great. My new favorite product.
Leaves my skin soft and smooth and a little more firm than usual
I tried some Avon product like the one I reviewed and the No. 7 product I'd thee best I tried. I recommended it to my mom and aunts!
I have watched my skin transform while using No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum. My skin is smoother and brighter. Also this has kept my skin nicely hydrated. I definitely recommend.

I really enjoyed using the No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum. My face is pretty dull especially in these Midwest winters, but while using this serum my face had a nice glow to it. The only thing I didn't love is that it has a string scent to it. It is a nice scent but it's a little to strong for my liking.

I received a free sample of the No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum to try and I was quite impressed. After using it for a few weeks, my skin looks more even and supple. I'm not sure at this point if I see a difference in my fine lines, but my skin definitely has shown improvement as far as lightening dark spots. My skin looks hydrated as well. It went on smoothly and absorbs nicely and quickly. My only complaint is the scent is a strong perfume scent. I don't mind scented products, I just didn't care for this one. Luckily, the results outweigh the fact that I don't like scent. I do recommend this serum, just be aware that it is scented if you have a sensitive nose.

I have used several No7 products so was excited to try the Lift & Luminate Serum - it did not disappoint! It went on smoothly and evenly and left my skin feeling really soft and nourished. When I removed the product at night my skin was left feeling silky smooth. I would certainly recommend this product and will continue to include in my daily regimen.

I'm thrilled with the opportunity to try the lift and luminate serum. I can't attest for long term results with only a week of use. Would've preferred to be able to try a month before rushing for review. It does make my skin feel great! It's very silky and soft. Goes on and smooths in easily. I would prefer it wasn't scented because using multiple products on my body makes for a lot of smells. I will continue to use this and hope to see great results on my fine lines. So far it's been great, non greasy and overall makes my skin feel so nice and soft. Thank you!

avis.titre: I really really seen a difference
avis.texte: I see a difference after using this item.it lifts areas I apply it to.. however I do need to use again by early evening. so twice a day and it works well.. its a product I will have to continue to use daily for results, its not a permanent fix. but will buy another tube and continue to use. I love testing the products Bzz has for me, because it gives me a chance to try items I normally wouldn't try. sometimes the product is to expensive to just try and may not like.. so being a bzz agent gives me the opportunity to try and see if I like well enough to keep buying... and when im pleased with a product I tell everyone !!!

avis.titre: More like an ointment than a Serum
avis.texte: Every serum I've ever used comes with a dropper and is super light and easy to spread on my skin. Thus, I was disappointed with my first use. This "serum" comes in a tube and is super thick, like petroleum jelly. But it dries very quickly, so you can only use a little at a time. I found that it works best by applying directly to my wrinkles and fine lines and then just rubbing it in. If you use too much, it will come off like little balls in your hands. It has a very strong perfumey scent that I don't like. Buttttt, after using this product for 2 weeks I have started to notice that my forehead wrinkles are much less noticeable! Unfortunately, it hasn't done anything for my melasma and sunspots. So as you can see I have very mixed feelings regarding this product. It is more like an ointment than what I would consider a serum. I think they should have marketed it as a wrinkle spot treatment instead.

Since using the lift & Luminate serum, I've noticed that the skin around my eyes has more moisture. It's also gentle on my skin which is extremely important for me. Overall, it has been a great part of my skin care routine.

avis.titre: Improves skin with only a few uses!
avis.texte: I received a free sample of this product, and found I loved how the No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum seemed to work wonders on my dry skin with only a few morning and evening applications. I smoothed this serum on my face and along my neck after cleansing every morning, and then added my usual moisturizer and sunscreen over it. I then made sure to use it in the evenings when winding down with my nightly routine after cleansing and before adding my night cream. I noticed soon after using (maybe a day or two) that my skin felt more supple and younger. Since my skin is usually dry, I was glad to notice no flaking away of skin cells or rough dry spots after using this serum. I don't currently have many visible wrinkles, but I was impressed by the way this seemed to eliminate the fine lines around my eyes and mouth. I would recommend this product for aging skincare.
Great serum for dry, sensitive skin. I have some redness from allergies and this really helped even out my skin tone.

After using this product for a about a week now, it did enhance the texture of my skin. After applying my skin was a lot softer. The fragrance was light and clean, which I enjoyed very much. It was a very soothing scent. I didn't see much reduction in the fine lines around my eyes and mouth. I also noticed it didn't really absorb into my skin very well. After a shower I applied it and waited almost 2 hours before applying my makeup and it still felt like I just applied it.

This No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum really is great.The packaging is easy to openThe tube is a good size,and will last.I am so pleased with how smooth and non gresy this goes on.It really makes my skin feel good and healthy looking.Its simple and It works.

A couple of days after starting to use this serum, I looked in the bathroom mirror first thing in the morning and noticed visibly brighter skin. I don't know if I can see a huge amount of life but something about my face looks brighter and more even.

Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum goes on smooth and feels like silk. I especially love that it helps with skin firmness, reduces wrinkles, and evens out skin tone - all which I need for my ripe age of 40! This is my new go to serum!
This serum is one of the best drugstore serum. Very light weight and best under my moisturizer and my foundation. I love it because it light weight since I don't like cakey feeling on my face.

The No.7 Lift and Luminary Triple Action Serum is super easy to use and it makes my face feel really soft. I have been using this for 4 days now and I'm starting to see a difference. I love the way it makes my skin feel.

I have only been using the Lift and Luminate Triple Action Serum for about a week, but I can already tell a difference! The serum has a pleasant, floral smell and glides on so smoothly. It doesn't take much to cover my face and neck. The serum rubs in easily and leaves my skin feeling silky. At 40, I am getting lines around my eyes and forehead as well as my neck. Since using the product as part of both my morning and nightly routine, I can already see the lines starting to diminish. I love this serum so far!
It's a little early yet to see any significant changes but I do like how light it is on my skin. Does not feel oily like other products sometimes do. Looking forward to seeing long term effects.

I've been using this product for a week now- twice a day. My skin is very soft and some of the texture I have been feeling is starting to smooth away. I also feel like I can see a brightness in my complexion that wasn't there. I'm looking forward to seeing the results after using the entire tube.
I love, love, love this product. It goes on silky smooth and makes a true difference in the look and feel of my skin. I will definitely buy it if I can find it where I live.
I absolutely love this serum. My face and neck feel so silky smooth after applying. My fine lines look lighter and my whole face looks plumper....lifted, hydrated, and smooth.

Thank you #BzzAgent for the opportunity to try this. I love it! I love that #No7 Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum is light and non greasy, it visibly reduced my fine lines and made my soft all day.

I have used this product for 4 days now. After cleansing my face and neck at night, I apply to my face and neck. Not only does it smell good, it feels great on my face. It doesn't feel sticky or make my face feel tight, like I thought it might. So far, I would highly recommend Lift and Luminate Triple Action Serum. I love the way it makes my face feel and my face does seem to look more clear and with less blemishes. I will definitely continue to use this product.

I started using Lift & Luminate Triple Action Serum. It has done miracles on my face and neck. Over a week of use I noticed lines and dark spot disappear. The serum didn't dry out my skin or give me break outs. I'm very impressed. I will be using this for now on.
1st time using 12/7 pm. Like what I've seen/felt so far. More will be revealed. Thanks...
I am loving the light, smooth feel! The smell is light and fresh and I have noticed a difference in my skin tone.
